meta.title: Online store
meta.seoTitle: Online store demo: catalog, cart, simulated checkout and reports
meta.seoDescription: Try a sample online store for Colombia: catalog with search and favorites, cart with pricing rules and coupons, simulated payment by card, PSE, Nequi, Daviplata, cash on delivery and Addi, order and inventory panel, simulated shipping labels, returns and sales reports in COP exportable to CSV. Runs on sample data.

demoEcommerce2.sampleDataHint: Sample store: products, customers, orders and figures are fictitious; payments, the invoice and shipping labels are simulated. What you do is saved only in this browser.
demoEcommerce2.footerNote: Demo with sample data. Orders, inventory and reports are calculated in your browser and saved only there (you can reset them). In your project we connect the payment gateway, the e-invoicing provider, carriers and your ERP.

reset.hint: Go back to the initial sample data
reset.title: Reset the demo
reset.body: This clears the changes saved in this browser: {n, plural, =0 {you have not placed orders} one {# order of yours} other {# orders of yours}}, created products, stock, rules and favorites. The demo goes back to the initial sample data.

tour.title: Suggested walkthrough

steps.cart: Add products to the cart in the store
steps.pay: Pay for a sample order (simulated payment)
steps.prepare: In the admin, move your order to preparing
steps.ship: In logistics, create the shipping label
steps.reports: See your order added up in the reports

tour.here: This step happens in this view: {step}.

time.d: {n, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} ago

toasts.addedLimited: Only {n} units of “{name}” are available: your cart now has {n}.
toasts.invoiceDownloaded: You downloaded the sample invoice for {order} (PDF).
toasts.copyFailed: Your browser did not allow copying; select the text and copy it.
toasts.csvDownloaded: You downloaded a CSV with {n, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}}.
toasts.hidden: “{name}” is no longer shown in the store.
toasts.restocked: You added {n} units of “{name}” to the {warehouse}.
toasts.returnCreated: You registered a return for order {order}.
toasts.riskRejected: You cancelled order {order} and its units went back to stock.

hero.title: Your online store, end to end
hero.subtitle: Shop in the store, pay with a simulated payment and follow the order in the admin, in logistics and in the reports.

search.placeholder: Search products by name or SKU...

sections.recommendedHint: Calculated from the sample orders of the last 30 days
sections.favoritesEmpty: You have no favorites yet. Tap a product’s heart to save it here.

product.inCart: You already have {n} in the cart
product.description: Sample product. In your store, this is where each item’s description, specs and warranty go.
product.taxIncluded: Price in Colombian pesos (COP), VAT included

cart.title: Your cart
cart.empty: Your cart is empty. Go back to the store and add products.
cart.couponInvalid: That coupon does not exist in the sample store.
cart.couponHint: Try the coupon BIENVENIDA10 (10% off). Pricing rules enabled in the store admin apply automatically.

address.title: Details and shipping address
address.deliveryEstimate: Shipping to {city}: {min} to {max} business days. Ships from the {warehouse}.
address.wantsCompany: I need the e-invoice issued to a company
address.consent: I authorize the processing of my personal data to handle this order (Colombian Law 1581 of 2012).
address.privacyNote: Demo: use fictitious data. What you type stays in this browser and is not sent to any server.

payment.title: Payment method
payment.subtitle: Payment methods commonly used in Colombia. In this demo the payment is simulated: nothing is charged and no gateway is contacted. In your project we connect the gateway you choose (for example Wompi, PayU, Mercado Pago or ePayco).
payment.cardHint: Do not enter real card details: nothing is sent or stored here.
payment.pseHint: In your real store, PSE shows the list of banks and takes you to your bank’s online banking. Here the approval is simulated.
payment.walletHint: In your real store you get a {wallet} notification to approve the payment. Here the approval is simulated.
payment.codHint: You pay in cash when you receive the order. The order stays pending payment until delivery.
payment.addiHint: Installments: in your real store Addi reviews and approves the credit. Here it is simulated and applies to purchases from {min}.
payment.declined: Payment declined by the simulated gateway (declined test card). Try another card or payment method.
payment.stockChanged: Stock changed: review your cart before paying.

errors.docNumber: Enter a valid document number (5 to 12 characters).
errors.phone: Enter a 10-digit Colombian mobile number starting with 3.
errors.consent: You must authorize data processing to continue.
errors.summary: Check the fields marked in red.
errors.cardName: Enter the name as it appears on the card.

summary.title: Summary
summary.subtotal: Subtotal ({n, plural, one {# product} other {# products}})
summary.shippingFlat: The free-shipping rule is off in the admin: shipping has a flat rate.
summary.rulesNote: Discounts come from the pricing rules enabled in the store admin.

confirmation.title: Sample order confirmed!
confirmation.titleCod: Sample order received! You pay on delivery
confirmation.subtitle: Simulated payment: nothing was charged, no email was sent and the invoice was not transmitted to the DIAN.
confirmation.cufeHint: Calculated in your browser with SHA-384 over the order data and a fictitious technical key, as defined by the DIAN. It is not valid and is not reported.
confirmation.delivery: Estimated delivery in {city}: {min} to {max} business days.
confirmation.whatsappTitle: Preview of the WhatsApp confirmation message
confirmation.whatsappText:
Hi {name}. We received your order {order} for {total} ({method}).
We will ship it to {city}; it arrives in {min} to {max} business days.
We will let you know when it leaves the warehouse.
confirmation.whatsappHint: Nothing is sent: in your project this message goes out through the WhatsApp Business API.
confirmation.seeInPanel: See the order in the admin

invoice.title: Sales invoice (sample)
invoice.notValid: Sample document generated by a demo: it is not a valid electronic invoice and was not transmitted to the DIAN.
invoice.footer: Sample store from the KopTup demo. In your project, the electronic invoice is issued by a DIAN-authorized technology provider or by your ERP.

guide.title: Create label for {order}
guide.simulatedNote: Simulated label and rate with illustrative values. In your project they are created through the carrier’s or a shipping aggregator’s API.

vendor.title: Store admin
vendor.subtitle: Orders, catalog, inventory and pricing rules of the sample store. Changes show up instantly in the store.

kpis.title: Last 24 hours
kpis.hint: Calculated from the sample orders and yours. The change compares with the daily average of the previous 7 days.
kpis.deltaHint: Versus the daily average of the previous 7 days

pricing.title: Pricing rules
pricing.subtitle: Turn them on or off: they apply instantly in the cart.

rules.volume10: 10% off when the cart is over {from}

catalog.title: Catalog and inventory
catalog.subtitle: Stock per warehouse, units sold in 30 days and days of inventory at the current pace.

form.name: Name
form.baseNameNote: Sample products keep their name; you can edit their price and description.
form.imageNote: The photo is downsized and saved only in this browser; it is not uploaded to any server.

errors.name: Enter a name with at least 3 characters.
errors.sku: Use 4 to 20 letters, numbers or hyphens.
errors.skuTaken: A product with that SKU already exists.
errors.price: The price must be between COP 1,000 and COP 50,000,000.
errors.stock: Enter a whole number between 0 and 5,000.
errors.image: We could not read that image (8 MB max).

catalog.restockNote: Simulates incoming goods. In your project, receipts are recorded from the purchase order or your ERP.
catalog.deleteConfirm: Delete “{name}”? It is removed from the store, the cart and favorites.

ops.title: Logistics
ops.subtitle: Warehouses, dispatch, shipment tracking, carriers and returns for the sample store.

dispatch.title: To dispatch ({n})
dispatch.hint: Orders already picked. {n, plural, =0 {No new orders waiting for confirmation.} one {# new order is waiting for confirmation in the admin.} other {# new orders are waiting for confirmation in the admin.}}
dispatch.empty: No picked orders. Move an order to preparing in the store admin.

tracking.title: Shipments on the way ({n})
tracking.hint: Simulated tracking: advance the events by hand.

carriers.title: National carriers
carriers.hint: Sample rates for a standard parcel to Bogotá; they are not real quotes. Disabled carriers do not appear when creating labels.

returns.title: Returns
returns.hint: Approving a return puts the unit back in stock, except for warranty claims (sent to technical review).

reasonHelp.retracto: In distance sales the buyer can withdraw within 5 business days after delivery (Colombian Law 1480 of 2011, art. 47).
reasonHelp.warranty: The product has a defect: it is reviewed and repaired, replaced or refunded under the warranty.
reasonHelp.size: The customer asks for another size or item.
reasonHelp.notAsDescribed: The product received does not match the store listing.

returns.already: There is already a return for that product in this order.

admin.title: Sales reports
admin.subtitle: Figures calculated in your browser from the sample orders and the ones you place in the demo.
admin.includesYours: Includes {n, plural, one {# order of yours} other {# orders of yours}} totaling {total} in sales.

kpis.hint: Net sales = product value after discounts, excluding shipping. Repeat rate = customers with 2 or more orders in the period. Cancelled orders excluded.

charts.dailyAria: Bar chart of sales by day
charts.maxDay: Best day in the period: {amount}. Hover over a bar to see the details.

insights.title: Recommendations
insights.hint: Calculated with simple rules over the data (not AI): inventory coverage, products bought together, weekly change by category and payment methods.
insights.restock: Restock “{name}”: {stock} units left, about {days} days at the pace of the last 30 days.
insights.pair: {pct}% of the orders with “{a}” also include “{b}” ({n} orders). Useful for a bundle or a cart suggestion.
insights.trendUp: {category} sales went up {pct}% versus the previous week.
insights.trendDown: {category} sales went down {pct}% versus the previous week.
insights.wallets: {pct}% of the orders in the last 30 days were paid with Nequi or Daviplata.

marketing.title: Marketing automations
marketing.hint: Audiences calculated from the orders. Emails are not sent in the demo: you can see the message each customer would get.
marketing.previewNote: Preview with the first customer in the audience ({n} in total). Nothing is sent.

postPurchase.title: After purchase
postPurchase.desc: Customers with an order delivered in the last 7 days: thank-you and review request.
postPurchase.subject: {name}, how did you like your purchase?
postPurchase.body:
Hi {name}.
Your order {order} has arrived. Can you tell us how “{product}” worked for you?
Your review helps other customers decide.

winBack.title: Win back
winBack.desc: Customers with no purchases in the last 21 days or more.
winBack.subject: {name}, we miss you
winBack.body:
Hi {name}.
We have not seen you in the store for a while. Your last purchase was “{product}”.
Here is the coupon BIENVENIDA10 for your next order.

replenishment.title: Coffee replenishment
replenishment.desc: Customers who bought coffee 20 to 30 days ago and have not bought it again.
replenishment.subject: {name}, running low on coffee?
replenishment.body:
Hi {name}.
Your bag of “{product}” from order {order} must be running out.
Order another one before you run out of coffee.

risk.title: Risk review
risk.hint: Sample rules on orders not yet dispatched: cash on delivery from {cod}, first order from {first} and 3 or more units of the same tech product. In your project the gateway’s anti-fraud rules are added.

rules.firstOrderHigh: High-value first order from the customer
rules.bulkTech: 3 or more units of a tech product

compliance.title: Regulatory requirements
compliance.subtitle: They are configured when your store is implemented; this demo does not process real payments or data.

dian.title: DIAN electronic invoice
dian.desc: Issued by an authorized technology provider or your ERP. In the demo, the invoice and the CUFE are samples.

habeasData.title: Data processing (Law 1581)
habeasData.desc: Consent at sign-up and checkout, a data policy and handling of inquiries and claims.

retracto.title: Right of withdrawal (Law 1480)
retracto.desc: Returns within 5 business days after delivery and payment reversal when applicable.

pci.title: Card data at the gateway (PCI DSS)
pci.desc: The store does not keep card data: a certified payment gateway captures it.
